posts.hook: Anthropic's own IPO paperwork says it might not notice when AI starts building itself
posts.caption: anthropic's filing says it may imminently meet its rsi threshold, investors want a lower ipo valuation, google takes down a 1.3m-device tv box botnet, apple posts a record quarter. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic's S-1 says it may "imminently meet" its RSI threshold
slides.desc: It may also miss the ==significant acceleration== until after it has happened.

terms.gloss: recursive self-improvement: ai building better versions of itself

slides.title: Investors want Anthropic's IPO priced near $1.5T to $1.6T, not about $2T
slides.desc: The tech selloff is feeding back into the biggest AI listing on the calendar.

slides.title: Google and partners dismantle a botnet of 1.3M Android TV boxes
slides.desc: The maker shipped a backdoor from the factory. Google cut ties and banned it.

terms.gloss: a network of hijacked devices run by one operator

slides.title: Can an LLM edit another model's weights? A viral claim meets a rebuttal
slides.desc: A post says Astra improved a small Qwen's math. Critics say not superhuman.

terms.gloss: the numbers inside a model that hold what it learned

slides.title: Apple posts record September-quarter revenue of $114.48B
slides.desc: But memory costs keep rising into December and inventory is up 31% on the quarter.

posts.hook: North Korea's $6.3B Binance heist started with a fake job interview
posts.caption: binance says north korean hackers used fake linkedin job interviews to steal $6.3b, google will turn search off in schools that refuse its ai, nvidia reportedly caps china at 49% of data center clients. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.3B using fake job interviews
slides.desc: A months-long ==social engineering== scheme plus malware ads, not a protocol flaw.

slides.title: Google will turn Search off entirely in schools that refuse its AI
slides.desc: Admins can't disable Gemini features and keep Search. Google says the two are deeply integrated.

slides.title: Nvidia reportedly caps Chinese customers at 49% of data center clients' business
slides.desc: Export-control policing moves onto the cloud operators. Nvidia has not confirmed.

slides.title: ChatGPT says it hit 1.2B weekly users, up 200M in 60 days
slides.desc: OpenAI's own figures: search volume is around 20% of Google's.

slides.title: A UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines
slides.desc: Malware that runs before Windows loads. The ==open question== is whether Secure Boot revocations left a gap.

terms.gloss: malware that runs in the startup code before the OS loads

slides.title: CrowdStrike buys two AI security firms for about $495M
slides.desc: Companies deploy agents faster than security teams can set controls.
